task_description: Implements a modulo-based string checksum calculator that verifies data integrity by maintaining a hash value of the data string. The core class uses loop invariants to ensure the checksum always equals the sum of the string's character values modulo 137 when appending characters. Provides methods for data retrieval and checksum verification, constituting a data integrity validation mechanism.
